_comment: Super R-Type (USA): the 18 sections of the game out of the cartridge — level records, scene tables, layer scripts, map streams as metatile references, metatiles (16 tile words + 16 collision nibbles), spawn lists, palette sets; formats in tools/srtlib.py; tools/dumplevels.py, checked by tools/matchlevels.mjs against the VRAM of the running original.
